description: CHARLOTTE, NC – Stacie McGinn, Republican candidate for Senate District 42, releases a new ad calling out her opponent Woodson Bradley’s rewriting of history around her involvement in Fortune Hi-Tech Marketing's pyramid scheme that defrauded over 350,000 consumers - including nearly 20,000 North Carolinians - of their life savings.

title: NEW AD: Stacie McGinn Calls Out Woodson Bradley's Rewriting of History Around Her Involvement in an Illegal Pyramid Scheme
